title: Geek Pictures Unveils Panchsheela Indian-Japanese Magical Girl Animation
content: Geek Pictures India announced on August 25 that it is working on what it described as an "original magical-girl anime" titled Panchsheela . Geek Pictures India describes the project as an India–Japan creative collaboration.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 (Finale) "Mugendai MewType" Preview Released
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 preview has been released on Tuesday. The episode is set to premiere on September 10 at 11:00 PM JST and it is titled “Mugendai Mewtype.” The synopsis is as follows: Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are.
author: Anime Corner

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 Main Visual Revealed
content: MARRIAGETOXIN has revealed its main visual for Season 2, which is scheduled to begin streaming in January 2027 . A new visual reveal PV was also revealed, along with an interview with director Motonobu Hori about the upcoming season.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dark Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Return After 4 Years With First Look
content: One of the darkest Shonen Jump anime series will be returning with a second season after almost four years. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have always been at the center of attention thanks to the exceptional stories they have to offer.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Isekai Takes a New Turning Point in Latest Season
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the light novel! The exciting Fall 2026 is less than a month away, which means most of the major Summer anime series are heading towards their finale. This also includes Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation , which premiered its Season 3 in July this year.
author: ComicBook

title: Marriage Toxin TV Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Promo Video, Key Visual
content: The staff of the second season of the television anime for Jōmyaku and artist Mizuki Yoda 's Marriage Toxin manga revealed a promotional video and a key visual for the season on Tuesday. The second season will debut in 2027 and will feature a returning staff.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Breakout Anime Hit Reveals First Look Trailer for Season 2 – Watch
content: One of the biggest Shonen Jump anime breakout hits of the year is coming back for Season 2 in 2027, and the first trailer is helping to show off the first look at what’s coming next.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Confirms New Spinoff Release For U.S. Fans After Season 3
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is all set to premiere next month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Hyūganatsu, the story primarily follows Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: Firefly Wedding Anime Reveals Key Visual at Advance Screening Event
content: Firefly Wedding TV anime revealed a new key visual during a screening event ahead of its October 9, 2026 premiere. The second promotional video was revealed in August. title: Black Clover Season 2 Announces October 3 Premiere
content: Black Clover Season 2 anime has officially announced that it will premiere on October 3, 2026. The anime previously revealed the main trailer and theme song by rock band WANIMA, as well as confirmed that Ayataka Tanemura will return to direct the anime’s second season.
